cues.zh: 大家好！
cues.en: Hey everyone!

cues.zh: 这周我经历了点小冒险。
cues.en: Well I had a bit of adventure this week.

cues.zh: 我在帮忙处理一些 GPL 合规的事。
cues.en: I was helping out with some GPL compliance.

cues.zh: 那是什么？
cues.en: What's that?

cues.zh: 简单来说——我知道评论区肯定有几百人要来纠正我，
cues.en: Well, in the most simple terms- and yes I know a few hundred of you are going to correct me in the comments section,

cues.zh: 但在这个具体场景下，GPL 的通俗版就是：如果你把美味巧克力蛋糕的配方给了我，
cues.en: but, the lay person's version of GPL in this specific case is, if you give me your recipe for delicious chocolate cake,

cues.zh: 我做了些改动让它更合我的口味，
cues.en: and I make a few changes to make it suit my tastes better,

cues.zh: 我就得把这些改动交给你和社区。
cues.en: I have to give those changes to you and the community.

cues.zh: 如果你设计了一台超酷的 3D 打印机并以 GPL 发布——许可证有很多种，规则各不相同，
cues.en: If you design a really cool 3D printer and release it under GPL- and there are many licenses with many different rules,

cues.zh: 我对它做了改动，那我就得告诉大家我改了什么，好让他们也受益。
cues.en: and I make changes to that, well I have to tell everyone what I did, so they can benefit also.

cues.zh: 意思就是：我愿意分享——但前提是你也愿意。
cues.en: It's saying I am willing to share- but only if you are also.

cues.zh: 当然，实际情况要复杂得多，但你可以去别处深入了解一下。
cues.en: Again, it's a lot more complicated than that but you can go read up on it elsewhere.

cues.zh: 描述框里有链接。
cues.en: Links in the description box.

cues.zh: 我刚开始接触3D打印时，大多数中国制造商并不遵守GPL协议。
cues.en: When I first got into 3D printing most Chinese manufacturers were not GPL compliant.

cues.zh: 他们会拿走配方，做些改动，却不说明改了什么——也不公布源代码。
cues.en: They would take the recipe, make changes, and then not say what they did- not publish the source code.

cues.zh: 我对此很在意，觉得既不诚实，也没必要，还让我们显得很糟糕。
cues.en: Well, I took that personally, I thought it was dishonest, unnecessary, and made us look bad.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，大多数中国人都认同我的看法，过去几年里我成功让许多3D打印机公司
cues.en: Fortunately most Chinese agreed with me and I was able to get many 3D printer companies over the past few years

cues.zh: 开始遵守GPL——不是全部，也不总是百分百做到——但确实有所改善。
cues.en: to become GPL compliant- not all, and not always 100%- but it did get better.

cues.zh: 我还负责了中国首批五个开源硬件协会认证的项目。
cues.en: I am also responsible for the first five, Open Source Hardware Association certified projects in China.

cues.zh: 因为总有一天你得开始做出更重要的贡献，
cues.en: Because there comes a time when you have to start making more significant contributions

cues.zh: 而不只是复制，如果人们觉得你只会复制，解决办法不是用言语争辩，而是用行动证明，
cues.en: and not just copying, and if people think all you can do is copy, the solution is not to argue with your words but your actions,

cues.zh: 我一直尽力做到这一点。
cues.en: and I've always tried to do that as best I can.

cues.zh: 我没有工厂，只有一个YouTube频道，还有一副大嗓门。
cues.en: I don't have a factory, just a YouTube channel, and a very loud voice.

cues.zh: 所以，当波兰开发者Patrycja难以从一家中国本地智能手机公司获取源文件时，
cues.en: So, when Patrycja, a developer in Poland was having trouble getting source files from a local Chinese smartphone company,

cues.zh: 有人想着碰碰运气，@了我，而我看到的情况让我很不满。
cues.en: someone thought to take a chance and tag me, and I was not happy with what I saw.

cues.zh: Android基于Linux内核，而Linux内核采用GPL第2版许可证，
cues.en: Android is based on the Linux Kernel, which is GPL version 2,

cues.zh: 而说必须有人亲自到他们深圳的办公室用中文提出请求，
cues.en: and saying someone has to come to their office in Shenzhen and ask in Chinese

cues.zh: 这让我作为中国人和开源倡导者，个人感到难堪。
cues.en: this was something that embarrassed me personally as a Chinese person and as an Open Source advocate.

cues.zh: 我们可以做得更好，至少我们有能力做到。
cues.en: We're better than that, or at least we can be.

cues.zh: 于是我是这么做的。
cues.en: So here's what I did.

cues.zh: 哦，记得点击下方CC按钮打开字幕，不然你会看不懂发生了什么。
cues.en: Oh make sure you turn on the subtitles by clicking the CC button down there or you won't know what's going on.

cues.zh: 你好，请问四楼有一家智能手机公司吗？
cues.en: Hi, is there a smartphone company on the fourth floor?

cues.zh: 智能手机公司？
cues.en: Smartphone company?

cues.zh: 是的，这个小区里只有一栋叫锦祺智谷的楼对吧？
cues.en: Yes, and only one building in this neighborhood called Jin Qi Zhi Gu right?

cues.zh: 是的。
cues.en: Yes.

cues.zh: 那这里有四楼吗？
cues.en: So is there a fourth floor here?

cues.zh: 有，往那边走。
cues.en: Yes, that way.

cues.zh: 谢谢。
cues.en: Thank you.

cues.zh: 好了，我现在在深圳南山区的UMIDIGI。
cues.en: Alright. I'm here at UMIDIGI in Nanshan, Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 我来找他们要GPL合规。走吧！
cues.en: I'm trying to get GPL compliance from them. Let's go!

cues.zh: 我来要内核源代码。Ben是谁？
cues.en: I am here for the kernel source code. Who's Ben?

cues.zh: Ben是谁？就是负责回复客户邮件的那个。
cues.en: Who's Ben? The guy who is in charge of replying to emails to customers.

cues.zh: 他已经离开公司了。
cues.en: He has left the company.

cues.zh: 他走了？
cues.en: He is gone?

cues.zh: 你确定？
cues.en: Are you sure?

cues.zh: 那前几天发邮件说——
cues.en: Then who sent the email a couple days ago saying that-

cues.zh: “想要内核源文件就自己来拿，顺便说一下，我们只说中文。”——的是谁？
cues.en: "If you want the kernel source file you have to come to get it yourself and by the way, we only speak Chinese."

cues.zh: 他很久以前就离开公司了。
cues.en: He left the company a long time ago.

cues.zh: 那还有谁能把源文件拷到U盘里？有什么给什么就行。
cues.en: Then who else can put the source files on the USB, anything you got is okay.

cues.zh: 那现在是谁在处理这些东西？
cues.en: Then who is dealing with this stuff now?

cues.zh: 那还有谁能处理这个？有人吗？
cues.en: Then who else can deal with this? Anyone?

cues.zh: 记住，是你们自己想这么做的。
cues.en: Remember you're the ones who wanted to do it this way.

cues.zh: 你好
cues.en: Hello

cues.zh: 你好
cues.en: Hello

cues.zh: 你好，有什么可以帮您的？
cues.en: Hello, how can I help?

cues.zh: 我来是想向Ben索取一份可共享的源代码。
cues.en: I am here to request a shareable source code from Ben.

cues.zh: 我们到这边谈吧。
cues.en: Let's talk over here.

cues.zh: 据我所知，你们公司的主要客户是外国人，对吧？
cues.en: As far as I know, your company's primary customers are foreigners, right?

cues.zh: 所以有个外国客户买了你们的手机
cues.en: So there is a foreign customer who bought your phone

cues.zh: 并要求提供内核文件以便修改，因为它是基于Android系统的
cues.en: and asked for the kernel files to make changes since it is based on the Android system

cues.zh: 而Android系统需要遵循Linux内核的GPLv2许可证。
cues.en: which needs to follow the Linux kernel GPLv2 license.

cues.zh: 那我们现在需要做什么？
cues.en: So what do we need to do now?

cues.zh: 我们需要把内核源代码给她，因为UMIDIGI F2在源文件中做了修改，却没有发布。
cues.en: We need to give her the kernel source code because UMIDIGI F2 has made changes in the source file but didn't publish it.

cues.zh: 好的。
cues.en: Okay.

cues.zh: 在回复中，Ben说Umidigi F2使用的芯片来自MTK，
cues.en: In the replies, Ben said the chip that used on Umidigi F2 is from MTK,

cues.zh: UMIDIGI能分享这些的权限有限
cues.en: UMIDIGI has limited power to share those

cues.zh: 但无论如何，只要你们有可以开源的的文件，
cues.en: but no matter what as long as you have files that can be open source,

cues.zh: 请把这些发给我，这样我就能展示给你的客户看。
cues.en: please send those to me so that I can show them to your customer.

cues.zh: 如果UMIDIGI不想这么做，那也没关系。
cues.en: If UMIDIGI doesn't want to do that. That's ok too.

cues.zh: 但请求源代码的人是个程序员，而Linux不是中国人开发的，Android也不是。
cues.en: but the person who requested the source code is a programmer and Linux is not developed by Chinese, neither is Android.

cues.zh: 外国人可能会说我们只会抄他们的东西，从不回馈。
cues.en: Foreigners might say we just copy their stuff and never give back.

cues.zh: 我知道这有可能，因为我一直在处理开源硬件的问题，这种情况经常出现。
cues.en: I know this might be a possibility because I have been dealing with open-source hardware issues and this has come up a lot.

cues.zh: 我告诉他们，我们中国人懂得感恩，所以我才需要来拜访你，向他们证明这一点。
cues.en: I told them we Chinese know reciprocation, that's why I need to pay you a visit to show them.

cues.zh: 你看，既然Ben已经搞砸了。
cues.en: Look, since Ben already messed up.

cues.zh: 说实话，我不是开源软件方面的专家，但我是来帮忙的。
cues.en: To be honest, I am not an expert on the open-source software stuff but I am here to help.

cues.zh: 我想知道目前我能做些什么来帮你，
cues.en: I would like to know what I can do at the moment to help you,

cues.zh: 但关于源代码，我不确定那个程序员能不能随便展示给别人看。
cues.en: but about the source code, I am not sure the programmer can just show it to anyone.

cues.zh: 但它是基于我们外国朋友的成果开发的，我们必须遵守 GPL 合规要求。
cues.en: But it is developed on our foreign friend's work, we have to be GPL compliant.

cues.zh: 无论你能从程序员那里拿到什么
cues.en: No matter what you can get out from the programmer

cues.zh: 把那些文件发给我，这样其他人就能判断 UMIDIGI F2 是否符合 GPL 合规要求。
cues.en: just send those files to me so that other people can decide if UMIDIGI F2 is GPL compliant.

cues.zh: 因为我不能告诉他们我们不符合 GPL 合规要求，我们中国人不是那样的。
cues.en: Because I can't tell them that we are not GPL compliant, we Chinese are not like that.

cues.zh: 他们会说我们是知识产权窃贼。
cues.en: They will say that we are IP thieves.

cues.zh: 有可能，所以我才来这里向他们表明我们不是那样的，我们会做正确的事。
cues.en: It's possible, that's why I come here to show them we are not like that and we will do the right thing.

cues.zh: 要不我加你微信，我们保持联系。
cues.en: How about I add you on Wechat and we will keep in touch.

cues.zh: 因为现在我不能随便让哪个程序员给你任何东西。我只是这里的员工
cues.en: Because right now I can't just ask any programmer to give you anything. I am just an employee here

cues.zh: 但我不负责那些事。我会先跟我老板谈谈，然后再看接下来怎么走。
cues.en: but I am not in charge of those things. I will talk to my boss first and then we will see how we go from there.

cues.zh: 好的。
cues.en: Sure.

cues.zh: 你觉得呢？
cues.en: What do you think？

cues.zh: 我同意。
cues.en: I agree.

cues.zh: 保持联系。
cues.en: Let's keep in touch.

cues.zh: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。
cues.en: Sure, thanks for your help.

cues.zh: 好，他们说会在微信上跟我聊，然后把东西给我。
cues.en: Okay, they said they are going to talk to me on WeChat and give me the stuff.

cues.zh: 他们说在消息/邮件里回复的那个人已经离职了。
cues.en: They said the guy who replied in the message/email has left the company.

cues.zh: 我不信。
cues.en: I don't believe it.

cues.zh: 他们只是想保全面子，但总比没有强。
cues.en: They are just trying to save face but it's better than nothing.

cues.zh: 现在，你会注意到一个有趣的地方：阻力并不大。
cues.en: Now, one of the interesting things you'll notice is there wasn't much resistance.

cues.zh: 没人对提供代码这个想法有太大意见——很多情况下这并非恶意，
cues.en: No one had a huge problem with the idea of providing the code- a lot of this isn't malice,

cues.zh: 也不是故意不诚实，有时只是惯性。
cues.en: or intentional dishonesty, sometimes it's just inertia.

cues.zh: 这些公司长期以来一直奉行不提供的政策，他们已经忘了原因，而且
cues.en: These companies have had a policy of not providing it for so long, they've forgotten why, and

cues.zh: 现实地说，如今他们在社区好感和良好宣传上能得到的，远多于可能失去的。
cues.en: realistically these days they have a lot more to gain in community goodwill and good publicity than they have to lose.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，他们愿意给我一个解释的机会。
cues.en: And fortunately, they were willing to give me a chance to explain that.

cues.zh: 访问结束后，我发布了一个短视频版本，结果火了。
cues.en: After my visit, I posted a short version of the video and it went viral.

cues.zh: 顺便说一下，整个中国编程社区都认同并支持我，这真的帮了大忙。
cues.en: And just so you know, all the Chinese coding community agreed and supported me, and that really helped a lot.

cues.zh: 我理解那里有很多不满情绪，我知道我们最近的历史以及这让很多人怎么想
cues.en: I understand there are a lot of hard feelings there, I know our recent history and what that makes a lot of people think

cues.zh: 但事情变化很快，我们大多数人不想再那样做生意了。
cues.en: but things change fast and most of us don't want to do business that way anymore.

cues.zh: 是的，光说没用，改变需要时间——但如你所见，我愿意采取行动，
cues.en: Yes, talk is cheap, and change takes time- but as you see I am willing to take action,

cues.zh: UMIDIGI一旦明白了也是如此。
cues.en: and so was UMIDIGI once they understood.

cues.zh: 在看到不仅是外国人，还有中国网民都坚持认为遵守GPL才是正确做法之后，
cues.en: After seeing that not just foreigners, but Chinese netizens insisted that being GPL compliant was the right thing to do,

cues.zh: UMIDIGI与我合作，确定了所需文件并发布了它们。
cues.en: UMIDIGI worked with me to determine what were the required files and post them.

cues.zh: 我在下方描述栏里放了他们的链接。
cues.en: I have a link to them in the description box below.

cues.zh: 帮个忙，其他公司都在观望这件事的结果。
cues.en: Do me a favor, other companies are watching to see what the outcome is here.

cues.zh: 他们是否愿意做正确的事、尊重知识产权、尊重许可证，都取决于这个结果。
cues.en: How willing they are to do the right thing, respect IP, respect licenses depend on that outcome.

cues.zh: 请大家评判 UMIDIGI 时，不要看他们最初的回应，而要看他们纠正错误的意愿
cues.en: Please judge UMIDIGI, not for their initial response, but their willingness to correct it

cues.zh: 他们没有怪我，也没有把我赶出办公室，没有为不合规行为辩护，
cues.en: they didn't blame me or kick me out of their offices, they didn't defend non-compliance,

cues.zh: 他们没有找借口，他们倾听了社区的声音，做了正确的事。
cues.en: they didn't make excuses, they listened to the community, and did the right thing.

cues.zh: UMIDIGI 的平价手机系列很扎实，性价比很高，去看看
cues.en: UMIDIGI makes a solid line of budget phones that is a great value, take a look

cues.zh: 如果有机会，请在社交媒体上@他们，让其他公司看到，做正确的事
cues.en: and if you have a chance please tag them on social media and let other companies see that doing the right thing,

cues.zh: 也是明智的商业选择。
cues.en: is also the smart business choice.

cues.zh: 我要感谢 Patrycja、Amy 和 Aryan 帮忙检查发送的文件是否正确，
cues.en: I'd like to thank Patrycja, Amy, and Aryan for their help checking that the right files were sent,

cues.zh: 也感谢 ETnews 和 OSChina 让中国网民参与进来。
cues.en: and ETnews and OSChina for getting Chinese netizens involved.

cues.zh: 这完全是团队的努力，虽然只有一家公司、也许只是很小的一步，
cues.en: This was entirely a team effort, and while only one company and a very small step, maybe,

cues.zh: 但也许，仅仅是也许，它会是倒下的第一张多米诺骨牌，让更多科技公司在这里合规并做正确的事。
cues.en: just maybe it will be the first domino to fall that gets more tech companies here compliant and doing the right thing.

cues.zh: 今天就到这里，请记得不仅要关注，还要打开通知，这样我发布新视频时你就能看到。
cues.en: That's it for today, please remember to not just follow but turn on notifications so you see when I post a new video.

cues.zh: 下次见——如果我能做到，任何人都能做到！
cues.en: Until next time- if I can do it, anyone can do it!

cues.zh: 虽然你们大多数人还没疯到会跑来冲着别人大喊要源代码，也许这是件好事。
cues.en: Although most of you aren't crazy enough to show up and start yelling at people for source code and maybe that's a good thing.
